name: supabase
description: Connects this site's assistant to a Supabase account through Supabase's hosted MCP server, and walks an operator who has nothing configured through it without a token ever passing through the chat. Encodes what generic Supabase knowledge gets wrong here: the primary connect path is an OAuth sign-in link Tovu self-configures (nobody types a client id or secret); a personal access token is only the fallback when that sign-in cannot start, and it is typed into a masked in-chat form, never into chat text; the connection is scoped to exactly one project and read-only by default, and no Supabase tool is offered until a project is picked; and a write tool such as execute_sql or apply_migration still needs the operator's separate per-tool write grant.
author: Tovu
